replacement:
- During the Release 1 pre-publication candidate-freeze window, candidate-frozen
  files do not change. Only `authority/release-1-gates.yaml`,
  `evidence/release-1/**`, and `generated/RELEASE-1-GATES.md` may evolve, and
  gate-registry edits are limited to release-state bookkeeping (`updated`,
  `state`, `decision`, `notes`). Any other content or gate-definition change
  requires a new candidate freeze and invalidates dependent evidence. Run
  `pnpm snapshot:manifest --check-candidate` before gate review continues and
  again before release, against that candidate checkout.
- After Release 1 publication, preserve the published tag, signed artifacts,
  candidate freeze and gate decisions. Successor development is checked by
  `pnpm validate`, including the `release-1-history` audit. A candidate-freeze
  mismatch on a successor checkout is not authority to re-freeze, re-sign or
  reopen the published release. Use the fixed candidate checkout when replaying
  its historical candidate-equivalence check.
